name: ChangeCollisionHelper
title: ChangeCollisionHelper - Global
summary: The ChangeCollisionHelper script include provides helper methods found in the Change Management - Collision Detector (com.snc.change.collision) plugin.
overview: Use these methods in server side scripts, or when using Ajax calls on the client. You must have the Change Management - Collision Detector plugin installed to use these methods.

members.name: addCiToChangeAffectedCis
members.summary: Adds the CI to the change's affected CI list.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
ci String The sys_id of the configuration item
changeId String The change record's sys_id
Returns
Type Description
void

members.name: getAffectedCisByChangeId
members.summary: Returns the Affected CI sys_ids for the given change.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
changeId String A change record's sys_id
Returns
Type Description
Array An array of sys_ids of affected CIs.

members.name: getBlackoutsByDate
members.summary: Returns any blackout that overlap the period defined by startDate and endDate.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
startDate GlideDateTime The beginning date
endDate GlideDateTime The ending date
Returns
Type Description
Array An array of blackouts (blackoutId:stringSpan).

members.name: getChangesWithAffectedCi
members.sig: getChangesWithAffectedCi(String ci, GlideDateTime startDate, GlideDateTime endDate)
members.summary: Returns changes scheduled in the timespan (defined by startDate and endDate) that have the given CI in their Affected CIs list.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
ci String The configuration item's sys_id
startDate GlideDateTime The beginning date
endDate GlideDateTime The ending date of the time span
Returns
Type Description
Array An array of change record's sys_ids

members.sig: getChangesWithCi(String ci, GlideDateTime startDate, GlideDateTime endDate)

Parameters

endDate GlideDateTime The ending date of the time span
